What does the Executive Briefing cover and what does it cost?

Executive Briefing from Dave Willemstein gives an executive team or board the same realistic picture of what AI means for the organization, including what it asks of them as overseers. The result is a shared picture and a decision agenda, built on sector-specific preparation. The session takes one half-day session incl. preparation and is priced as a fixed project fee, set out in the proposal, excluding VAT and travel expenses.
When is the Executive Briefing price credited?
Executive Briefing is fully credited if AI Readiness Assessment starts within 60 days.
How many people attend an Executive Briefing?
Executive Briefing works best with five to twelve participants; more than twelve shifts the format from a conversation to a presentation.
Can the Executive Briefing be held online?
Executive Briefing can be held online, though an on-site session works better: the conversation between board members themselves is half the value.
Source: Dave Willemstein's rates and typical timelines. Updated: October 2026.

From four opinions to one decision agenda.
